title: A Survey on AI Sustainability: Emerging Trends on Learning Algorithms and Research Challenges

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review of fairness in sociotechnical systems, citing examples like the COMPAS risk assessment system, and discussing fairness metrics (e.g., demographic parity) and mitigation algorithms.
Literature review summarizing data biases and algorithmic biases, as well as pre-processing, in-processing, and post-processing mitigation strategies.
Literature review examining unexpected social implications and biases in AI systems regarding poverty and protected attributes.
Literature review examining unexpected social implications and biases in AI systems regarding disabilities.
Literature review of recommendation system biases where user behavior mimics friends rather than reflecting true preferences.
Literature review of recommendation system biases where popular items receive disproportionate algorithmic exposure at the expense of less popular items.
